Cover: Three-quarters (3/4), Defense +6; ordinary Reflex bonus +3 against effects beyond the cover (apply separately to the save).

Aquatic Training: +1quarter scenery cover before attacker reductions.

Home Turf: +1quarter scenery cover before attacker reductions.

An attack that would hit without the cover Defense bonus hits the cover instead. The GC resolves cover Damage saves, penetration and which combined cover is hit.

DEX 1; dodge bonuses removed 0; security-device bonus +0; adjacent Eye of the Storm bonus +0.

Uncanny Dodge grade 0; vulnerable no; flat-footed no; flanked no; helpless no.

Attacker modifier +0 (pinned target, adjacent melee/unarmed +0; prone target 0; crouched target 0; blinded target +0; helpless target within Melee Range +0). Coup de Grace target eligible: no.

Known sneak attack immunity: no.

Listed DR before armor piercing/type exceptions: melee weapons 4, unarmed 4, non-grenade hurled weapons 4, other ranged weapons 4, other 4.

Pinned grants adjacent unarmed/melee attackers +4; Held alone grants no such bonus (p.342).

The helpless-target +4 applies only within Melee Range. Coup de Grace normally requires an adjacent helpless opponent and its normal full action/shot; other character options require their actual exceptions. This check does not resolve the attack.

Invisible-attacker blindness also affects vision checks and other attack effects; those are separate from this Defense calculation.
